environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 API deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B2 tier). Exposed via Azure Application Gateway with URL-based routing, no WAF policy attached. JWT bearer authentication is configured but tokens are issued to any registered developer via self-service portal. The LDAP backend is Active Directory 2019 on a domain-joined VM in the same VNet. Network Security Group allows TCP 389 from the App Service subnet. No input validation middleware is configured.

config.gateway: Azure Application Gateway v2, no WAF SKU
